title: Letter to Church Leaders in Jackson County, Missouri, 21 April 1833
source_note: JS, Letter, Kirtland Township, Geauga Co., OH, to “Brethren in Zion,” [Jackson Co., MO], 21 Apr. 1833. Retained copy, [ca. 21 Apr. 1833], in JS Letterbook 1, pp. 32–36; handwriting of Frederick G. Williams; JS Collection, CHL. For more complete source information, see the source note for JS Letterbook 1.
